title: Toward Secure and Compliant AI: Organizational Standards and Protocols for NLP Model Lifecycle Management

bias_targets.methodology: The paper does not conduct empirical measurements but proposes a governance framework (SC-NLP-LMF) that evaluates performance disparities across protected attributes using toolkits like the IBM AI Fairness 360 Toolkit and Fairness Indicators during model training and validation, as illustrated in a narrative healthcare case study.
